ns2:course.label: Landscape Plan & Design Studio
ns2:course.description: Ecological design and planning studio emphasizing design that reflects evaluation and integration of human and environmental research results. Detailed investigation of design options. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: LA 441 and LA 450, or consent of instructor.
